title: Insomnia mod
description: This is a insomnia mod I made In my free time because I was bored, this has multiple effects.
body:
This is an insomnia mod I made in my free time because I was bored. This can do multiple stuff like hallucinations, effects from not sleeping, or even stopping you from sleeping.
